channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Conversion prints landed outside Texas overnight while Austin’s permanent ≥75 MW rule is still on the morning clock. NVIDIA’s 9 Sep Newsroom release named eight Australian partners (Firmus, Sharon AI, IREN, Megaport, ResetData, CDC, NEXTDC, AirTrunk) for up to 2 GW of DSX AI-factory capacity by 2027 — a national MW target tied to named operators, still power-gated. Separately, Reuters (10 Sep) reported Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei and Cambricon lifting indicated accelerator prices 20–50% as grey-market HBM costs bite after Dec 2024 advanced-HBM export curbs. In Texas, PUCT Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended adoption of new 16 TAC §25.194: $50k/MW security, forfeiture cut 80%→20%, interconnection fee removed) remains Item 24 on the 11 Sep open meeting; Interchange showed no 11 Sep adoption filing as of this morning’s scrape. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 56 re-read list prints.

item.title: Compute brief — 11 September 2026
item.description: Conversion prints landed outside Texas overnight while Austin’s permanent ≥75 MW rule is still on the morning clock. NVIDIA’s 9 Sep Newsroom release named eight Australian partners (Firmus, Sharon AI, IREN, Megaport, ResetData, CDC, NEXTDC, AirTrunk) for up to 2 GW of DSX AI-factory capacity by 2027 — a national MW target tied to named operators, still power-gated. Separately, Reuters (10 Sep) reported Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei and Cambricon lifting indicated accelerator prices 20–50% as grey-market HBM costs bite after Dec 2024 advanced-HBM export curbs. In Texas, PUCT Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended adoption of new 16 TAC §25.194: $50k/MW security, forfeiture cut 80%→20%, interconnection fee removed) remains Item 24 on the 11 Sep open meeting; Interchange showed no 11 Sep adoption filing as of this morning’s scrape. Countries: Australia: NVIDIA 9 Sep: up to 2 GW DSX AI factories by 2027 with eight named AU partners. IREN Bundey 800 MW cited; CDC >550 MW live + 800 MW under construction. No programme capex. China: Reuters 10 Sep exclusive: Huawei Ascend 950DT indicated >¥250k (20–50% up vs two months); Cambricon 690 +20–30%. HBM scarcity / grey market after Dec 2024 US controls. Unconfirmed by companies. United States / Texas: PUCT 58481 on 11 Sep agenda (Item 24). Staff order still the live text; no Interchange adoption stamp yet as of morning scrape (~8:50am PT). United States / Texas: IREN Sweetwater 2 GW still conditional Base Load in ERCOT Batch Zero (8 Sep PR). Verification/audit path continues.
